originalTitle: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
title: Big News from Far, Far Away Lands!
content:
Hello from Your News Reporter!

Hi everyone! I’m your friendly news reporter, bringing you exciting stories from all over the world, even from countries very far from us here in Africa. Today, we have a story about leaders, countries, and some special rules. It might sound tricky, but we will make it super simple! I hope you are all having a wonderful day. Let's learn something new together! We will talk about some big countries and their very important leaders.

Meet the Leaders!

Imagine your school principal. They are the leader of your school, right? They make sure everyone is safe and happy. Well, big countries also have leaders! They are like the principal for a whole country. One of the leaders we are talking about today is **President Trump**. He used to be the leader of a very big country called **America**. America is far away, across a huge ocean. Another leader in our story is **President Zelensky**. He is the leader of a country called **Ukraine**. Ukraine is also very far away, in a place called Europe. Did you know? A president is chosen by many people in their country to help lead and make important decisions!

Countries Far, Far Away

So, we have three main countries in our story today: America, Russia, and Ukraine. Let’s imagine them as three big families living in different neighborhoods. **America** is a very, very big country. It has many cities and lots of people. President Trump was its leader. **Russia** is an even bigger country! It is so big that it crosses two continents. It has lots of snow in some parts and big forests. **Ukraine** is another beautiful country, quite close to Russia. Did you know? Russia is the biggest country in the world! It is so big, it takes many, many hours to fly from one side to the other.

What Are "Special Rules"?

Sometimes, countries don't always agree. Imagine you and your friend have a disagreement. Maybe you stop sharing your toys for a little while, right? You make a 'special rule' that says, "I won't share my red car with you today." Well, countries sometimes do something similar. They make 'special rules' for other countries. These special rules are called **sanctions**. It's a big word, but it just means one country puts rules on another country. These rules might mean: "We won't buy things from your country," or "We won't let our people visit your country as easily." It's like giving another country a 'timeout' or saying, "We are not happy with something you did." Did you know? Countries talk to each other all the time, just like you talk to your friends and family! This helps them get along.

Why Did America Make These Rules for Russia?

For a while, America and some other countries were not happy with some things that Russia did. So, America’s team of lawmakers, which is called **Congress**, decided to make some of these special rules, or sanctions, for Russia. These rules were made to show Russia that America wanted things to be different. It was like saying, "We want you to play nicely with everyone." Congress is a very important group of people in America. They work hard to make laws and rules that help the country. Think of them as a big team of grown-ups who help the president. Did you know? Laws are like the rules we follow at school or at home. They help everyone know what to do and what not to do!

President Trump Changes Some Rules!

Now, here's the big news! President Trump, the leader of America, decided to make a change. He decided to **temporarily stop** many of these special rules that America had put on Russia. "Temporarily stop" means he stopped them, but maybe not forever. It's like pressing a pause button on a game. The rules are paused for a little while. Why did he do this? The news says it was because of **"national security" concerns**. This sounds like a big phrase, but it simply means President Trump was thinking about what was best to keep America very, very safe. He thought that for America to stay safe, it was important to change some of these rules for a little bit. Sometimes, leaders make different choices because they think it's the best way to protect their people. Did you know? Leaders of countries always try to make decisions that keep their people safe and happy. It's a very big job!

A Little Disagreement

At the same time this was happening, President Trump and President Zelensky, the leader of Ukraine, were having a **disagreement**. This is like when two friends don't agree on something. It's called a 'row' in the news. They were not seeing eye-to-eye on some things. Even leaders of different countries can have disagreements sometimes. It's part of how countries talk and work with each other. This disagreement was happening while President Trump was making changes to the rules for Russia. It’s important to know that countries often have many things happening at once! Did you know? It's always good to talk about disagreements calmly and try to understand each other's point of view!

Why This News is Interesting!

So, why is this news interesting for us, all the way here in Africa? Even though these countries are very far away, what their leaders do can sometimes affect the whole world, or teach us about how countries work. It shows us that leaders have very big jobs and make many choices. These choices are about friendship between countries, and about keeping people safe. It’s like learning how different families in a big neighborhood try to get along. Sometimes they agree, sometimes they have rules, and sometimes they change the rules! Did you know? Learning about other countries helps us understand the big, wide world we live in!

Let's Be Friends!

Learning about these big words and actions helps us understand the world better. It’s a bit like learning new words in a storybook. We learn about leaders trying their best to lead their countries. Even with special rules and disagreements, many countries try to be friends and work together. That’s why listening to the news, even simple news like this, is important. Thank you for listening to this big story from far away lands! I hope you learned something new today. Keep being curious and asking questions! **The End!**
summary: America's old leader, President Trump, temporarily stopped some special rules (sanctions) on Russia because he thought it would help keep America safe, even while he was having a disagreement with Ukraine's leader, President Zelensky.
whyMatters: This news shows how leaders of big countries make important choices about other countries, sometimes changing rules to keep their own people safe, and how countries sometimes have disagreements, which is interesting to learn about how the world works.

title: Pedro Neto's Big Goal Party! Chelsea Wins!
content:
Hello, Super Sports Fans!

Hello everyone, it's your friendly reporter here, bringing you super exciting news from the world of football! Imagine a big green field, two teams, and lots of running and cheering! That's what happened this past Saturday, and guess what? It was a super fun game! We are going to talk about a very special football match. It was between two big teams called Chelsea and Everton. They played a game where everyone ran really fast and tried to score goals. And one player, Pedro Neto, was like a superhero!

What is Football?

First, let's talk about football, or soccer as some call it! It's a game where two teams try to kick a round ball into the other team's net. This net is called a goal. When the ball goes into the net, it's a 'goal,' and your team gets a point! The team with the most points at the end of the game wins. Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in the whole world! Lots of kids just like you love to kick a ball around with their friends. Maybe you do too!

Meet the Teams: Chelsea and Everton

In our big story, we have two important teams. One team wears blue, and they are called Chelsea. The other team is called Everton. They are both really good at playing football. They both wanted to win the game very much! Imagine your favourite two friends playing a game together. They both try their best, and that's like Chelsea and Everton. They play fair and try to be the best team.

The Big Game Day: Saturday!

This exciting match happened on a Saturday. Saturdays are great for playing games and having fun, right? People came to watch from everywhere, making lots of noise and cheering for their favourite teams. It was a happy day for sports! Imagine hundreds of people all singing and clapping! That's what it sounds like at a big football game. Everyone is so excited to see who will win.

The First Half of the Game

Every football game is split into two parts, like when you read a book in two sittings. The first part is called the 'first half.' In the first half of this game, both teams ran a lot. They passed the ball and tried very hard to score. But guess what? No one scored a goal yet! It was a bit like a chase, with players trying to get the ball. They were showing off their amazing skills, dribbling the ball with their feet. The goalkeepers were also very busy, stopping the ball from going into their nets.

Pedro Neto: Our Goal-Scoring Star!

Now, let's talk about our special player, Pedro Neto! Pedro plays for the Chelsea team. He is very good at running with the ball and kicking it. He is a super fast player who makes exciting things happen on the field. Did you know? Football players train very hard every day to become good. They practice running, kicking, and working together as a team. This helps them play their best during a game.

The Second Half Begins!

After a short break, the game started again. This part is called the 'second half.' Everyone was still waiting for a goal! The players were a little tired, but they pushed themselves to try even harder. They knew this was their chance to win. Sometimes in a game, you have to wait for the best part. And for this game, the best part was about to begin! The fans were buzzing with excitement, hoping their team would score.

Pedro Neto Scores the First Goal!

And then, *whoosh*! Pedro Neto did something amazing! He got the ball, ran super fast, and *kick*! The ball flew right into the Everton goal! Everyone cheered very loudly! Chelsea had scored a goal! It was a truly exciting moment. The Chelsea fans jumped up and down, clapping their hands and shouting with joy! Pedro Neto smiled because he helped his team get closer to winning. One goal down!

Another Goal from Pedro Neto!

But Pedro Neto wasn't finished! He wanted to help his team even more. A little while later, he got another chance. He kicked the ball again, and *whoosh*! Another goal! Two goals from Pedro Neto for Chelsea! This was incredible! Scoring one goal is great, but scoring two goals in one game is super special! The Chelsea team was so happy, and the fans were even louder now. They knew their team was playing wonderfully.

What is an 'Away Win'?

Now, let's talk about what an 'away win' means. When a team plays at another team's home stadium, it's called an 'away' game for them. So, Chelsea played at Everton's home. When Chelsea won the game there, it was an 'away win' for them! It's a bit like winning a game when you visit your friend's house. It feels extra special because you won in a new place! Chelsea showed great strength by winning away from their own stadium.

Teamwork Makes the Dream Work!

Even though Pedro Neto scored the goals, football is all about teamwork. His teammates passed him the ball, helped defend their goal, and worked together. Everyone on the Chelsea team helped them win that day. Did you know? Good teamwork means helping each other and playing together, not just by yourself. It's like when you and your friends work together on a school project or play a game. Everyone helps!

Why This Game Was Important

This win was very important for Chelsea. It means they get points in the league, which helps them try to win the big trophy at the end of the season. Every game counts, and every goal helps! It also shows that if you try your best, even if it's hard at first, you can achieve great things, just like Pedro Neto and his team.

Keep Playing and Having Fun!

So, Pedro Neto was the star of the day with his two amazing goals, helping Chelsea get a big 'away win' against Everton. It was a fantastic game, full of excitement and great sportsmanship. Remember, playing sports is great for your body and your mind. It teaches you about teamwork, being fair, and never giving up. So go out there, kick a ball, and have fun! See you next time for more exciting news!

originalTitle: Ranking the Premier League's all-time greatest super subs
title: Meet the Awesome Football Heroes Who Come Off The Bench!
content:
Hello, Football Friends!

Hi everyone! Welcome to our super fun news show about football! Do you love watching brave players kick a ball and score goals? Football is a game where two teams try their best to put a round ball into the other team's net. It's super exciting! Today, we're going to talk about a very special kind of hero in football. These heroes might not start the game, but they come in to save the day! Imagine a big, famous football game place in a country far away called England. They play in something called the Premier League, where many amazing players show off their skills.

All About Teams!

In football, each team needs many players to win. Only eleven players from each team can start the game on the field at the very beginning. They run, kick, and try their hardest. But what about the other players? Where do they go? Well, a football team has more than just eleven players! The other players sit on a special seat at the side of the field. This seat is called the 'substitute bench.' They watch the game very carefully, waiting for their turn to play.

Meet the Substitute Players!

Sometimes, a player on the field gets a little tired. Running for a whole football game is a lot of work! Or maybe the coach, who is like the team's captain and thinker, wants to try a new plan to help the team win. So, what happens then? That's when a player from the substitute bench can come into the game! This player who comes in is called a 'substitute'. It's like when you're playing a game with your friends, and someone new comes to join in to help. It brings fresh energy to the game! Did you know? In a football game, a team can change up to five players! This means many players get a chance to play and help their team.

The Magic of a "Super Sub"!

Now, listen carefully! Some substitute players are EXTRA special. They are like secret weapons! These players come into the game usually when it's almost finished. This is when the game is very close and exciting. Maybe their team needs a goal very badly to win! Or maybe the other team is winning, and they need a hero to help catch up. These amazing, special players are called 'Super Subs'! When a Super Sub jumps onto the field, they bring lots and lots of energy. They run super fast, they pass the ball super well, and they are ready to do something amazing. Everyone watching gets very excited when a Super Sub comes into the game!

How Do Super Subs Save the Day?

Imagine a football game is tied, 0-0. No team has scored any goals yet, and there are only a few minutes left! It's a bit boring, right? Then, the coach sends in a 'Super Sub'! The Super Sub gets the ball, runs past everyone like a superhero, and *WHOOSH*! They kick the ball with all their might, and it flies right into the net! They score a GOAL! The crowd goes absolutely WILD with happiness! Everyone cheers very loudly. Or maybe their team is losing by just one goal, and time is running out. The Super Sub comes on and helps score not just one, but two goals! Suddenly, their team WINS the game! They are like heroes who come at the very last moment to save the day, making everyone so happy. Did you know? Sometimes, a Super Sub can score a goal just a few seconds after running onto the field! That's super speedy and super surprising for everyone!

Why We Love Super Subs!

Super Subs show us something very important about teamwork. They teach us that every single player on a team is important, no matter if they start the game or come in later. Even if you don't start, you can still be a big hero! These special players bring fresh energy, new ideas, and a lot of courage to the game. They make the football match exciting right until the very last second. The fans cheer extra loud and jump with joy when a Super Sub does something amazing, like scoring a winning goal. It's like getting a wonderful surprise gift for the team!

Always Be Ready!

Even when a player is sitting on the substitute bench, they are not just resting. Oh no! They are always watching the game very, very carefully. They are thinking about how they can help their team if they get the chance to play. They keep their bodies ready to run fast and kick the ball hard. They stay focused and ready. So, when the coach finally calls their name, they are ready to jump up and play their very best! This teaches all of us a good lesson: always be ready for your chance to shine and do something great! Did you know? Being a Super Sub needs lots of skill, a strong heart, and the courage to step up and make a big difference when your team needs you most!

Hooray for Our Heroes!

So, next time you watch a football game, look for the players sitting on the bench. One of them might be a Super Sub, waiting patiently to make a big, big difference! They are true heroes of the game, bringing so much excitement and joy. They remind us that we can all be super, no matter where we start in a game or in life. Every player's contribution counts! Hooray for Super Subs, the game-changers and surprise heroes of football!
summary: Super subs are special football players who come into the game from the bench to help their team score goals and win, even at the last minute.
whyMatters: It's important to know about super subs because they show us that everyone on a team is important, and you can be a hero even if you don't start, bringing excitement and fresh energy to the game.

originalTitle: Do Manchester City have any grounds to win their appeal?
title: Football Team Man City: Can They Change a Big Decision?
content:
Hello, My Amazing Friends Across Africa!

Hello, hello, my lovely friends! It's your friendly news reporter here, bringing you exciting stories from around the world. We know how much you love football here in Africa, right? It's a game of skill, speed, and lots of cheers! Today, we are going to talk about a very famous football team called Manchester City. They play in a big league far away in England, but many of you wear their blue jerseys and cheer for them!

Meet Manchester City!

Manchester City is a super-duper famous football team. They are known for playing wonderful football and winning many trophies. Their team wears bright sky-blue shirts. Imagine a bright, sunny sky! That's their colour. Many, many people, even here in Africa, love to watch them play. They have many talented players who run fast and score amazing goals. Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in the whole wide world! Lots and lots of kids, just like you, dream of kicking a ball for a big team one day. We see so much talent on the football fields right here in Africa!

What Are Rules, Anyway?

Now, my friends, every game and every place has rules, right? Think about playing a game with your friends. You have rules like 'don't push' or 'you can't touch the ball with your hands' (unless you're the goalkeeper!). Rules are super important because they make sure everything is fair. They help everyone play safely and have fun. If there were no rules, games would be messy and not fun at all! Did you know? Even when you are at school, you have rules! Like 'listen to your teacher' or 'don't run in the corridors'. These rules help everyone learn and stay safe.

Football Has Money Rules Too!

Big football teams like Manchester City need to spend a lot of money. They buy talented players, pay for their coaches, and build big, beautiful stadiums where fans can watch games. It costs a lot to run a top team! The big football league in England, which is called the Premier League, has special rules about money. These are called "financial rules." These money rules are like making sure everyone shares their toys fairly. Or like when your parents tell you to save some of your pocket money and not spend it all at once! The rules make sure that teams spend their money in a smart way. It stops teams from spending too much and getting into big trouble later. It also tries to keep the competition fair for all the teams. Did you know? Some famous football stadiums can hold more than 50,000 people! That's like gathering all the people from many, many villages in one place to watch a game!

Oh No, Man City Broke a Rule!

Well, my friends, something happened with Manchester City. A special group of people looked at how Manchester City was spending its money for a long time. And they found that Manchester City did not follow some of these important money rules. This means they were found "guilty." Being guilty means that the people who checked said, "Yes, Manchester City did something that was against the rules." This is a bit like if you were playing a game, and someone said you kicked the ball out when you weren't supposed to. It's a serious matter for a big team.

What is an Appeal?

When a team, or anyone for that matter, is found guilty, they might feel that the decision is not fair. So, they can ask for another look! This is called an "appeal." An appeal means asking someone higher up, someone very important, to check the decision again. They want this person to listen to their side of the story very carefully. Manchester City is saying, "Please, let's look at this again. We think there might be a mistake, or we didn't do anything wrong!" Did you know? An appeal is like when you tell your teacher that you finished your homework, but she thinks you didn't. You might ask her to look inside your book again, just in case!

Is it Easy to Change a Big Decision?

Now, here is the tricky part, my friends. Changing a big decision, especially one made by a very important group, is not easy. A clever lawyer, someone who knows a lot about rules, said that Manchester City faces "big problems" or "tall walls" to climb if they want to win their appeal. It means they have to work very, very hard to show that the first decision was wrong. They need very strong reasons and lots of proof. Imagine trying to push a very, very big rock up a hill! That's how hard it might be to change this decision. They have to show everyone that they did follow the rules, or that the rules were misunderstood. It's a big challenge for the team. Did you know? Lawyers are like special guides who help people understand all the complicated rules and laws. They help make sure everyone gets a fair chance to tell their story.

What Might Happen Next?

So, what happens now? Well, there are two main things that could happen. If Manchester City wins its appeal, it means the people checking the case again say, "Okay, you were right! You did not break the rules!" This would be good news for them. But if they lose their appeal, it means the first decision was correct. They will still be found guilty. If they lose, there could be some punishments. Maybe they could have points taken away from their games in the league. Or they might have to pay a lot of money as a fine. But no matter what, it's very important that everyone, even big football teams, follows the rules to keep the game fair and fun. Did you know? Losing points in a football league means a team might not win the championship, even if they played very well! Every point counts!

Why Are Rules Important for Everyone?

This story about Manchester City reminds us why rules are so important. Rules make sure that every team has a fair chance to win. They stop one team from getting a super big advantage just because they have more money than others. It teaches us all a big lesson: everyone must follow the rules, no matter how famous or how big they are. It’s like sharing your toys with your friends – it makes playtime much fairer and happier for everyone! We love football because it's exciting, full of energy, and everyone tries their very best. We will keep cheering for our favourite teams, knowing that fair play makes the game even more wonderful! Stay safe and keep playing, my friends!
summary: Famous football team Manchester City is trying to change a decision that says they broke important money rules, but it will be very hard for them to win their appeal.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows that even big football teams must follow rules, especially about money, to keep games fair for everyone, just like in any game or at school.
